'''Poplar''' is a wood type that arrived with ''Minecraft'' 26.3. It grows as tall trees with red, orange or yellow autumn leaves in the dappled forest. [[Matcha Flavoured]] gives poplar the same [[stonecutter]] recipes as the other woods, a [[Lumberjack]] trade, a leaf-to-sapling recipe, and its own tree height and textures.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
Poplar trees with red, orange or yellow leaves generate in the dappled forest biome, some with fallen leaves around them, along with fallen poplar trees.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/placed_feature/trees_dappled_forest.json}}</ref> The pack makes the trunk of every one of these trees two blocks taller than in vanilla ''Minecraft'' (a base height of 9 instead of 7).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/red_poplar.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/orange_poplar.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/yellow_poplar.json}}</ref> A tree can carry shelf mushrooms.

=== Leaves ===
Poplar leaves drop only themselves, and only when broken with shears or a tool with {{MCW|Silk Touch}}. They drop no saplings or sticks, like every leaf in the pack.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/red_poplar_leaves.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/orange_poplar_leaves.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/yellow_poplar_leaves.json}}</ref> A red, orange or yellow poplar leaf block is crafted into a poplar sapling. Picking up a poplar log unlocks the recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/poplar_sapling_from_poplar_leaves.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/poplar_leaves.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
A [[Lumberjack]] at the apprentice level sells 64 poplar logs for 1 [[obol]] and a poplar sapling.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/leatherworker/2/poplar_log.json}}</ref>

=== Stonecutting ===
A [[stonecutter]] cuts any poplar log (a log, wood, or the stripped form of either) into other poplar blocks, as it does for the other woods:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/poplar_planks.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! From !! Into
|-
| One poplar log or wood || 4 planks, 8 slabs, 4 stairs, 3 fences, 4 trapdoors, 8 buttons, 4 pressure plates, 2 doors, 2 signs, 1 fence gate or 1 shelf
|-
| One poplar plank || 2 slabs, 2 buttons, 1 stairs or 1 trapdoor
|-
| Poplar stairs || 1 planks
|-
| Poplar trapdoor || 1 slab
|-
| Stripped poplar log, poplar wood or stripped poplar wood || 1 poplar log
|-
| Stripped poplar log, poplar log or stripped poplar wood || 1 poplar wood
|}

Poplar boats, boats with chests and hanging signs, and the stripped log and wood, are as in vanilla.
